rates.merchants: United tickets, upgrades, Economy Plus, inflight, bag fees
rates.note: Bought from United. Excludes third-party travel packages, some discount sites, United Cruises, Merchandise Awards.

rates.merchants: Renowned Hotels and Resorts for United Cardmembers
rates.note: Via Chase Travel; prepaid hotel stays. FROSCH bookings do not qualify.

benefits.name: United Club membership
benefits.notes: United Club card membership for the primary cardmember (+1 adult guest and dependent children); upgrades to All Access (Star Alliance lounges, 2 guests) with Premier Gold or higher or $50,000 in calendar-year purchases.

benefits.name: Renowned Hotels credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit for prepaid Renowned Hotels and Resorts stays booked through United Hotels; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Rideshare credit
benefits.notes: Up to $12/month in statement credits on rideshare purchases ($18 in December, $150/yr total); opt in every calendar year.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: Two $10 Instacart credits each month in your Instacart account; Instacart+ membership included through 12/31/2027.

benefits.name: Avis / Budget credit
benefits.notes: Paid as United TravelBank cash: $50 on each of the first two Avis/Budget rentals booked via mileageplustravel.united.com per cardmember year.

benefits.name: JSX credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit on flights booked directly with JSX; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: FareLock credit
benefits.notes: Statement credit on United FareLock purchases; resets each cardmember year.

benefits.name: Free checked bags
benefits.notes: First and second standard checked bags free for the primary cardmember and one companion on the same reservation (United/United Express-operated flights; ticket bought with the card, MileagePlus number on the reservation).

benefits.name: Premier Access
benefits.notes: Priority check-in, security, boarding and baggage handling (where available) for the primary cardmember and companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Better-together bonus miles
benefits.notes: 5,000 bonus miles each account anniversary year when the business card's authorizing officer is also primary cardmember on a personal Chase United card.

benefits.name: Economy Plus upgrades
benefits.notes: 2 global Economy Plus seat upgrades after $40,000 in purchases in a calendar year; valid 12 months.

benefits.name: Avis President's Club
benefits.notes: Avis President's Club membership for the primary cardmember; enroll at united.com/AvisChaseBenefit.

benefits.name: United Club passes (All Access)
benefits.notes: 4 United Club one-time passes after each cardmember anniversary, only if you hold United Club All Access (Premier Gold or higher, or $50,000 in calendar-year purchases) and have an employee card on the account.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter if DashPass was first activated 2/1/2025-8/31/2026 (monthly if first activated 9/1/2026-12/31/2027), while enrolled in DashPass via the card. Source: DoorDash Chase co-brand terms (help.doordash.com); the United card page does not mention DashPass.

benefits.name: 25% back on inflight
benefits.notes: 25% statement credit on food, beverage and Wi-Fi purchases on United/United Express flights and on premium drinks at United Clubs.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.notes: 12 months of complimentary DashPass when first activated with the card by 12/31/2027, then auto-renews at the paid rate until cancelled. Source: DoorDash Chase co-brand terms; the United card page does not mention DashPass.
